corrections.text: The headline says Grafana 13.2.4, 13.1.8, 13.0.11 and 12.4.13 'Fix Four' CVEs. The release notes for 12.4.13 list fixes for three of them (CVE-2026-15577, CVE-2026-33374, CVE-2026-93294); CVE-2026-95502 is listed only in 13.2.4, 13.1.8 and 13.0.11, and its advisory lists no 12.x fixed version. The release notes also carry a separate Enterprise SCIM entry, CVE-2026-92539, which is not one of the four.
